newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.2962 on Friday from Thursday's 8.2968 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai due to speculative buying, traders said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2969.
Dealers said speculative buying in the last few minutes of trading pushed the yuan to end up on Friday but the rise was not likely to change a consolidating trend in the short term.
The yuan opened slightly down at 8.2969 and moved in a stable and narrow range between 8.2965 and an intraday low of 8.2970 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.2959 in late trading.
Trading was dull with most done at about 8.2967.
One dealer said the weekend factor, which sees traders doing less business on Fridays, was the reason behind the narrow trading band.
"The yuan was seen gaining support around 8.2970 yuan," he said.

A second dealer said that after the yuan failed to breach the key resistance level of 8.2950 early this week, its downward trend would continue in the short term, consolidating around 8.2970 on Monday.
The yuan ended slightly up at 6.7300 from 6.7382 against 100 Japanese yen and unchanged at 1.0719 vs the Hong Kong dollar.
